youtube_short.title: The $47K Tax Trick Hiding in Your Losing Stocks
title_alternatives: Your Losing Stocks Are Actually Worth Money
Turn Red Stocks Into Tax Savings — Most Investors Skip This
youtube_short.description: You've got losing positions sitting in your portfolio right now — and here's the thing most brokers never tell you: the IRS built a legal trick to turn those losses into real money back. It's called tax-loss harvesting. Sell a loser, cancel your gains tax dollar for dollar. No gains? You still get to deduct $3,000 straight from your regular income every single year. Lose more than $3K? Those extra losses carry forward forever — they never expire. One catch: the wash-sale rule. Wait at least 31 days before buying back the same stock. Over 30 years, doing this consistently saves the average investor $47,000. Check your portfolio today. #taxlossharvesting #investing #personalfinance #stockmarket #taxes #finance
